items.verbatim: LOCAL 23 ADDITIONS & REMODEL / New additions for the Plumbers and Pipefitters Union building.  A new entry vestibule will be added to improve circulation.  Additional storage spaces have been added.  Two new classroom spaces are being added and a new rigging shop with restrooms as been added as well
